youtube_title: Dog Charging at You: Run or Stand Still? Brave vs Normal #25 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL #25. An unknown dog comes barking at you in the gali. Brave runs, Normal stands still. Who's right? Comment B or N!
Answer: Normal. US CDC: if an unfamiliar dog approaches, remain motionless and avoid direct eye contact. Run and it may chase you. If bitten, wash the wound with soap and water for 15 minutes and see a doctor the same day.
Source: US CDC 'Staying Safe Around Dogs'; WHO rabies first aid.
